summary.text: Devlin Robinson is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania Senate for the 37th District, which includes parts of Allegheny County.
He was elected in November 2020, reelected in November 2024, and chairs the Labor and Industry Committee.

paragraphs.text: Robinson was raised in Brookline, a neighborhood in the south end of Pittsburgh, and attended Central Catholic High School, according to his official biography.
He then joined the U.S. Marine Corps, continuing a family tradition of military service dating back four generations, and served one combat tour in Afghanistan and two in Iraq.

After his honorable discharge he founded a company, Veterans Medical Technology, and earned an associate's degree from the Community College of Allegheny County, a bachelor's degree from Robert Morris University and an MBA from the University of Pittsburgh's Katz School of Business.

In the Senate he is vice chair of the Transportation Committee and a member of the Banking and Insurance; Community, Economic and Recreational Development; Institutional Sustainability and Innovation; Law and Justice; and Appropriations committees.

The biography says he has had ten bills signed into law, including one in November 2025 to improve early literacy, and that he championed legislation creating an Urban Search and Rescue Task Force in western Pennsylvania.
He chairs the Pennsylvania-Ireland Trade Commission and is vice chairperson of the Port of Pittsburgh Commission.
